preconditions.description: The number of rows and columns n must be between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The number of ones k must be between 0 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (len(stdout.split()) == n*n and all(x in ['0', '1'] for x in stdout.split()))
postconditions.description: The output must be either '-1' or a string representing an n x n matrix with only '0' and '1' characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or sum(x == '1' for x in stdout.split()) == k
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the number of '1's in the matrix must be exactly k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(stdout.split()[i*n + j] == stdout.split()[j*n + i] for i in range(n) for j in range(n))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the matrix must be symmetrical with respect to the main diagonal.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or (stdout != '-1' and not any(stdout.split()[i*n + j] == '1' for i in range(n) for j in range(n) if stdout.split()[j*n + i] == '0'))
postconditions.description: If the output is not '-1', the matrix must be symmetrical with respect to the main diagonal, meaning if there is a '1' at position (i, j), there must also be a '1' at position (j, i).
